svg.text: Strip frame demo test - frame route and what you should see
D9: 18 pixels (1 pixel = 1 chip = 3 LEDs = 10 cm) around the frame. D10: one pixel (3 LEDs) pulsing.
bottom 6, right 3, top 6, left 3 pixels (18 = 54 LEDs)
strip: pixel 1 at the lower-left corner, then to the right (counter-clockwise) up to pixel 18 on the left side
at 16 each light turns back (34 steps/cycle).
Cycle lengths: red 17 s, green 13.09 s, blue 11.32 s.
Pixels turn around at both ends; LED 13 blinks.
D10: one pixel (3 LEDs), a pulse dark -> bright -> dark every 3 s, a new colour at every pulse
Each box: dark (start) - bright (peak, 80 of 255 on the strongest channel, after 1.5 s) - dark again. Order: red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, violet, white, then again.
The LED on pin 13 is shortly inverted at every turnaround of a frame light and at every new pulse colour.
Wrong colours: change COLOR_ORDER in the sketch (see README).
D11: colour bar of 6 pixels (60 cm): red, green, blue, cyan, violet, white, moving on one pixel every second towards pixel 6
After 6 s the sequence is back where it started (the colour that leaves pixel 6 returns at pixel 1). Peak brightness 80 of 255.
D12: pixel test, 10 pixels (1 m), four phases, repeats after 24.6 s - every pixel must take part in every phase
2a fill, 5 s: pixels light up 1 -> 10 and stay on
3 colour channels, 6 s: all together red, green, blue, white (1.5 s each)
4 runner, 3.6 s (0.2 s per step): one blue pixel 1 -> 10 -> 1
If a pixel is dead, the pixels after it usually stay dark in the fill (phase 2a). Wrong colours in phase 3: change COLOR_ORDER. Peak brightness 80 of 255.
